g.text: Does a larger GPU expert tier help?
Native int4 · same 32 GB RAM expert cache · tensor-core GEMMs disabled · independent server starts
Dots = independent server starts; bars = medians. Each start contains four correlated HTTP requests.
Throughput includes prefill and HTTP overhead; TTFT is a proxy. One machine, uncontrolled OS cache, no significance claim.
